people.name: Gederah
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Baal-hanan and Jozabad

people.name: Netaim
people.line: A place associated with potters in Judah

translations.web: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah: they lived there with the king for his work.
translations.bsb: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king.
translations.kjv: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
translations.asv: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
